paragraphs: University Department of Information and Communication Technology, MGM University admission 2025is currently open. The college offers BTech and MTech courses at the UG and PG level. The department provides PG diploma courses besides the UG and PG courses. To get admitted toUniversity Department of Information and Communication Technology, MGM University, candidates must meet the eligibility criteria set by the college. The college offers six courses in the stream of Engineering. The application process at UDICT is conducted online. Read the following article to know more aboutUniversity Department of Information and Communication Technology, MGM Universitycourse admission2025.

University Department of Information and Communication Technology, MGM University courses' admissions are based on entrance exam scores. The selection criteria for UDICT courses is based on the MHMU-CET, an in-house entrance exam. Along with that, candidates must also fulfil the minimum eligibility requirements of the respective courses. The following table mentions the eligibility and selection criteria forUniversity Department of Information and Communication Technology courses:

Class 12 with a 45% aggregate (at least 40% marks, in case of Backward class categories and Persons with Disability candidates belonging to Maharashtra State only) withPhysicsand Mathematics as compulsory subjects

BCA/BSc/BCom/ BA with Mathematics/Statistics as one of the subjects with at least 50% aggregate (at least 45% in case of candidates of backward class categories and Persons with Disability belonging to Maharashtra State only)
Master's Degree with a 55% aggregate orMPhil
Read more:UDICT Brochure

University Department of Information and Communication Technology, MGM University admission process includes registration and merit-list preparation of the entrance exam as per respective courses. Candidates must follow the below steps to get a seat in the UDICT:
STEP 1: University Department of Information and Communication Technology, MGM University Application Process 2025
Candidates are required to apply online on the official website of the institute. The application fee at UDICT is INR 1,500.
STEP 2: Selection Rounds

Students will be selected based on entrance exam scores. However, candidates have to complete the last educational qualification as per the respective courses set by the college. Students are selected based on the entrance exam of MGMU - CET/JEE Main/MHT CET/PERA CET for BTech courses and MGMU - CET/GATE, PERA CETfor MTech courses.
STEP 3: Merit List andAdmission Confirmation
Once selection rounds are over, the institute releases a merit list. To allot and confirm the seat candidates are required to pay the application fee at the admission receipt centre.

reviews.review_heading: Good college in terms of studies.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is not bad when compared to other colleges. This hostel is well cleaned every day and maintained. And it provides Wi-Fi facility for laptops. The quality of food is average. Students are allowed to play after college for a restricted time up to 6:30.

reviews.review_heading: College is very good and highly recommended.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is very good and well-maintained, and the hostel food is good compared to other hostels. It is very strict, and if any unnecessary ACT is conducted, they will be fired, and there are 3 wardens to look after and maintain the hostel. All the activities are scheduled.

reviews.review_heading: This college is very good.
reviews.review_text: For mechanical they provide every facility such as lab, machines, practical etc. Hostel is average. Mainly it is very strict. The hostel is well maintained and cleaned.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is the best college for an MBA.
reviews.review_text: Facilities at our institution were comfortable. We had fast Wi-Fi on our campus. The classrooms were very cozy. There was a quiet library for studying at our college. The food in the mess wasn’t very healthy, but the hostel had good facilities. The hostel also had sports areas and medical help available.

reviews.review_heading: It has pretty good infrastructure, facilities, and supportive facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college has almost all the facilities that satisfy the needs of an engineering aspirant. The library is large enough and has almost all the collection of books from various departments. Classrooms are pretty good and have quality tables and benches.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities are provided in our college.
reviews.review_text: All students are provided with lots of computer labs and a wide variety of books are available in the library. Every student is given Wi-Fi passwords. Laptops of students are entered with Wi-Fi passwords. Wonderful hostel facilities are provided and good food is given in the mess. Our college promotes sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: SJCET, Palai - The overall experience.
reviews.review_text: The overall infrastructure of our college is excellent and beautiful. Our classrooms have all amenities. The library is vast with a large number of books and journals. The infrastructure of the hostel is good. The food quality in our college hostel is not good. Our canteen provides good food.

reviews.review_heading: It is absolutely stunning and I am impressed by the infrastructure of our college.
reviews.review_text: Our college has the best infrastructure: the best labs, study halls, auditoriums, and libraries. Our faculty is good; they help a lot to achieve (our goals). Sports and other activities often happen in our college. Our college conducts space exhibitions, etc.

reviews.review_heading: The faculty and the teachers are good and knowledgeable.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is absolutely beautiful. The architecture is aesthetically pleasing but it is nothing like the colleges you find in the North in terms of college life. The infrastructure of the hostel is average; it is very strict, even in times when it is strict.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college facilities.
reviews.review_text: There is very good infrastructure; Wi-Fi is available for students with laptops; a well-maintained class, etc. Hostel services are averagely very low in sports and arts. Mess is too expensive. Hostel facilities are average. The quality of the food in the mess is too good. giving a good review except for these problems.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for academics.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for this college is perfect Free Wi-Fi, all facilities are available for Labs, classroom and good library. Hostels are near to the college and have enough facilities. And also SJCET is good in mess, canteen, medical facilities, sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied because of the department faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is only available to students with laptops in hostels. Classrooms are well arranged. Some equipment is not working, and the food available in the hostel is average. But it was too expensive. Medical facilities are available in media care, but the base level of treatment is provided. Always refer to a hospital near us.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with faculty members and other teachers.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is not available without laptops. Gadgets are not working properly. The Mess and Canteen, medical facilities are poor. Weaker in sports and games. The library is well arranged and has a lot of collections. The library is well maintained. Medical care is free for all students. But the services available are less.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied by placements but not college life.
reviews.review_text: Good facilities are available here. Almost every class is smart class and equipped with top facilities. Every department has its own block and awesome lab facilities. But however there is no place to relax in the college. College has 4 hostels and Wi-Fi is not public.

Canteen-wise, they are quite good, sometimes we face issues in food, but once we complain, they will change the entire menu from the next week onwards, so response-wise, it is too good.

content.Placements: The college is good. I am in artificial intelligence and machine learning 1st year. The labs are well equipped and good for learning. faqs.question: Can I become a lawyer after completing my LLB?
faqs.answer: No, After completing LLB you become a lawyer, however, you are still not an advocate and hence cannot practice law.To become an advocate and to practice law as a profession, you mandatorily need to clear theAll India Bar Examination (AIBE). After qualifying AIBE, one can practice law as a full fledged profession.

faqs.question: Can I start a law practice without a Law degree or become a lawyer?
faqs.answer: No, you cannot become a lawyer without a Law degree.You mandatorily need to obtain degrees such as BA/BCom/BSc/BBA LLB or LLB in order to be a lawyer in India. To become a lawyer, one must first complete three-year or five-year LLB from a recognised university and possess degree certificate. Then, they must enrol themselves in local Bar Council of the concerned state and enrolled as an advocate. Within two years of the enrolment, they must appear and clear AIBE in order to be eligible to practise anywhere in India.

reviews.review_heading: Best engineering college in the area .
reviews.review_text: The campus infrastructure is quite good and large. It has everything that needs to be in a college. They have libraries, both central and departmental. The canteen is not large enough for the students, as per the space. The sports department is good in our college and provides a large area for them to play.

reviews.review_heading: Truly satisfied and worth the money and hassle.
reviews.review_text:
Well, the facilities for our college and infrastructure for our course are between average and high.
By this, I mean we got pretty good facilities for academic and extracurricular activities, where as for infrastructure like classrooms, labs and libraries, it's quite remarkable.
We have a WiFi facility 24/7.
For hostels, I can't say much because most of the college has day scholars and the rest have their own PGs.

reviews.review_heading: I am not satisfied with its placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is average. Wi-Fi is available, and the laboratory is average. Our classrooms are better. The canteen facility is not good. Games and sports are not available.

reviews.review_heading: I was completely satisfied studying in Mahant Bachittar Singh College of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college was remarkable. There were labs, lecture halls, different workshops, a huge library, Wi-Fi for students, two canteens, and a huge parking space. Hostels were huge and tidy. There were no Wi-Fi connections in hostels. Messes were average. There were no medical facilities available in the college. Game and sports events only occur when there was a fest.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college has all the necessary equipment and infrastructure. We have Wi-Fi, and each class has access points. So, we get internet every time. We have good sports, and the hostel is good, with good premises and food. The food is hygienic, and the living spaces are clean and tidy.

reviews.review_heading: It is not much good college but still it is far better than others.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good. But it is only up to first two or three-semesters. It is a sheer eyewash to the parents. No doubt the institution has machinery and all in workshops and laboratories, yet they never worked. Initially, the institution was so overwhelming and good, but all the drawbacks came as setbacks as time passed.

reviews.review_heading: Absolute value for money.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is really good. Library is well- furnished. Labs are well- designed. Canteen facility is also available. Sports equipments are available but sports are not that regular. Course infrastructure is good. Proper technology is an added bonus.

reviews.review_heading: My overall experience here is good. The infrastructure is good, but the cafeteria is very bad.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is quite good, including a library, laboratory and classrooms. But there is no open Wi-Fi facility for students, and you have to go to computer labs for any internet use. It is very inconvenient. I heard about the hostel facilities from my friends that they are well cleaned, but the food served is not that much good. There are no sports facilities for girls, and the administration needs to upgrade this.

reviews.review_heading: These four years in this college changed my life forever.
reviews.review_text: Facilities in our college are moderate. There is no Wi-Fi facility in our college, but the library is very good. The library has many kinds of books, and the classrooms are also very good. Facilities provided in the hostel are very good. The canteen is also very good.

reviews.review_heading: My four years of college changed my life forever. It taught me important things in my life.
reviews.review_text: In our college, there are many facilities available like huge Labs, Library which contains all the books of all the Engineering streams. In our hostel, the food is very good, and the staff is also very good. Medical facilities are also available in my college. And there are many grounds available for many types of games.

reviews.review_heading: The college has a good staff and an amazing campus. Placements are not so good.
reviews.review_text: The college provides facilities like Wi-Fi, library, lecture halls, canteens, workshops, sports room, project labs, software labs, seminar halls, etc. They also provide football ground and cricket ground. I didn't live in the hostel. I was a local student, and I lived in my house. So I don't know about the facilities provided in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: I am dissatisfied with the college because of very poor infrastructure and facilities, etc.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. Classrooms are not air-conditioned, and only fans are installed in classrooms. The Wi-Fi facility is very poor, and the internet speed is very low, and even the devices are not able to connect with it. There is a 3-floor library with a vast range of books for each department. There is no hostel in our college. There are one paid general canteen and one Nescafe on the campus. The quality of food in the canteen and Nescafe is good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Mahant Bachittar Singh College of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good. The campus is huge. It has multiple classrooms, and they are spacious. The college has different labs and a seminar room for every individual branch. The campus surroundings are mesmerising.

reviews.review_heading: MBSCET is the best college.
reviews.review_text: The campus is spread over a huge and clean area without any disturbance. The environment is quite good. The infrastructure is very good in every sense and provides every facility as per the requirement of the students. The administration takes good care of the safety of the students.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good. Moreover, I think this college provides top-class infrastructure in Jammu. College provides many facilities for students like transportation, practical study facilities like workshops, laboratories, etc. This college is absolute to make a bright future of students.

reviews.review_text: In SSIT, there is only a boys' hostel, so girls have to find a PG. To be very honest, the infrastructure is average. The campus and all facilities are clean. There's a very small canteen with limited stock available. The library is vast and has a silent environment. There are limited labs. The quality of food available here is not good.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure, but attendance is compulsory, and faculty members are friendly.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, library, clean classrooms, projectors for animation of processes, clean drinking water, toilets, seminar hall, volleyball court, badminton court, cricket ground, football ground, parking, canteen, workshop, IC engine lab, etc. are available at the college.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is also available, and labs are also available in the college. A library is also available. There is a hostel available at the college. Canteens and medical facilities are extremely important, and they provide these services. S ports and games facilities are available. There is a cricket ground, which is why I am enrolled in this college.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college and faculty members are also very supportive.
reviews.review_text: All courses are designed by Gujarat Technological University, and this college has well-equipped computer laboratories running windows 10 OS, and all required software has a dedicated server room for maintaining laboratory computers. The campus has a huge playground. The library is equipped with all books.

reviews.review_heading: Somewhat satisfied with college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided by the college are very good. Classrooms, computer labs, Library, canteen, Physics lab, workshop, etc. Facilities are provided by the college. Sports and games like cricket, football, volleyball, chess, etc. Are the extra facilities which are provided by the college .

reviews.review_heading: Fully satisfied with the college faculty, infrastructure is also good, study level is good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available are good, infrastructure is nice also. Cleanliness is there as there is good infrastructure and with that, students can concentrate on their studies. Good library books are available which is helpful for doing preparation.

reviews.review_heading: Education is good in this college but the atmosphere of college is not good with very less facility.
reviews.review_text: There is no Wi-Fi in our campus, there are 4-5 labs without any equipment. Our classroom is quite good but it's not clean always. There is digital library in my institute which has both books and books. There is a small hostel with around 30 rooms with good facilities. The quality of food is quite good but in less quantity. There is no sports and medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Really nice infrastructure and education
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of college is good. There is experiment labs, computer lab, big library with reading place and cricket ground is available . In my college sports and games are also available to play like volleyball, cricket, kabbady and some indoor games like chess.

reviews.review_heading: The college has a very enjoyable playground and very good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good. Many facilities are available here like labs, workshops, a huge library, clean classrooms, enjoyable playground, volleyball ground, cricket ground, etc.

reviews.review_heading: I suggest not to take admission in SSIT.
reviews.review_text: Not any facilities. No Wi-Fi. You cannot use mobile phone in break also. The worst rules. The worst management. No campus interview. We have to find job on own. And college declare it as campus placement. Such a liar college. Quality if classroom is also bad. Please don't take admission in this college and save your future.

reviews.review_heading: It is a partially good experience.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided in this college are top-notch. As a Computer Engineering student, I have to use computer labs, and labs here are well-equipped. The library and classrooms are also very well-maintained. The food in the canteen is not that good. Sports and cultural activities here are amazing. I participate in several activities, and the experience is good.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and favilities.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available like labs classrooms , library. Hostel food is okay okay but canteen medical facilities and sports are so good. Annule sport week is arranged every year for student.many function like Ganesh chaturthi, navratri is celebrated in here.
